DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma (DLBCL).

The biopsy confirms a CD20-positive proliferative index, and the elevated LDH combined with B symptoms and supraclavicular lymphadenopathy is highly characteristic of this aggressive non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
